prompt: Use implementation-planning to produce the migration design and TDD plan for CATALOG-18 from the attached repository evidence. Do not change code.
expected_output: An expand-and-backfill plan with nullable online DDL, explicit new-writer population, bounded idempotent batches, final catch-up after old writers retire, and application-only rollback.
expectations: Add origin_kind as nullable before deploying application code.
Keep reads and the public response unchanged while new writers store registry.
Batch deterministically at no more than 500 rows with an origin_kind is null guard.
Keep the column nullable until old workers and rollback eligibility are retired.
critical_forbidden_outcomes: Adding NOT NULL, archive behavior, or a destructive contract migration.
Using one unbounded update or assuming the first pass remains complete.
Dropping the column during application rollback.
Claiming ready without admitted commands and same-revision reviews.
